prompt: A tiny sapphire-winged faerie with cerulean skin hovers in mid-air, side profile, having just flickered into existence. With a flick of her hand she yanks a heavy armored knight off his feet; the knight is dissolving into a swirl of bright blue motes and being pulled away, no longer solid. The faerie is small and fast, the knight much larger. The background is a pale dawn sky over a green meadow with soft clouds.

A small blue faerie with iridescent dragonfly wings hovers in the foreground, glowing. Behind her a snarling green ogre is being sucked backward into a swirling cerulean vortex, his body stretching and breaking into ribbons of blue light as he is banished. The faerie is tiny and serene; the ogre is huge and panicked. The background is a twilight forest clearing under a deep blue sky.

Extreme close-up of a mischievous blue faerie zipping diagonally across the frame at high speed, leaving a streaking trail of motion-blur and sparkling cerulean light behind her. Her gauzy wings are a translucent silver-blue blur. She grins, darting too fast to catch. The background is a sunlit blue sky with wispy clouds smeared by her speed.

A delicate blue faerie hovers and taps a charging warhorse on the nose with a slender silver wand. At the wand-tip the warhorse is popping like a soap bubble, its body collapsing into a shimmer of pale blue iridescent film and bursting into spray. The faerie is calm and tiny; the horse is large and mid-gallop. The background is a green tournament field under a clear sky.

A tiny cerulean faerie with butterfly wings flits in mid-air, hand outstretched toward the viewer. A large armored soldier in the foreground is being whisked off his feet and pulled toward her open palm, his body already half-dissolved into a stream of glowing blue motes spiraling into her hand. The faerie is small and impish; the soldier is big and off-balance. The background is a stone courtyard at dusk under a blue sky.

A small sapphire faerie with bright translucent wings hovers in mid-air, side profile facing right, having just appeared. To her right a large armored knight is mid-stride but already half-erased: his upper body and helmet have dissolved into a cloud of glowing cerulean motes and sparkles drifting upward, his legs still solid on the grass. The faerie is tiny and untouched; the knight is large and vanishing. The background is a green field under a pale morning sky.

A tiny cerulean faerie with gauzy dragonfly wings hovers brightly in the foreground. Beside her a large green troll is caught in a swirling whirlpool of blue light, his body spiraling and stretching into glowing ribbons as he is yanked off the ground and banished into the vortex. The faerie is small and calm; the troll is huge and flailing. The background is a misty blue swamp at dusk.

A small impish blue faerie hovers in profile, wings spread, one hand snapping her fingers. The snap sends a burly orc warrior tumbling backward through the air, his body breaking apart into a streak of blue motes as he is flung out of the scene. The faerie is tiny and smug; the orc is large and airborne. The background is a sunlit grassy hill under a bright blue sky with clouds.

A sleek blue faerie with long translucent wings banks sharply through open sky, three-quarter view, trailing a ribbon of sparkling cerulean light. She is fast and graceful, mid-turn, hair streaming. The background is a vast sunlit sky of pale blue with layered white clouds and distant green hills far below.

A tiny bright-blue faerie with shimmering wings hovers low in the foreground, side profile, having just flashed into being. A heavy armored ogre looms behind her but is dissolving from the feet up into a column of swirling cerulean motes and light, his outline coming apart as he is bounced away. The faerie is small and luminous, the only solid thing; the ogre is large and disintegrating. The background is a dim blue stone courtyard at night, the faerie glow the only light.
